appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'
Pie chart with four colored segments, each labeled with a source and percentage.
The 'Nuclear (45%)' segment is the largest by area, positioned between 'Fossil Fuels (30%)' and 'Hydroelectric (10%)'.
The 'Fossil Fuels (30%)' segment is larger than 'Renewables (15%)' and 'Hydroelectric (10%)', but smaller than 'Nuclear (45%)'.

public_definitions: Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
